p.s: While some people who like traveling alone disagree with that opinion, but I totally agree with that opinion that the best way to travel is in a group led by a tour guide.
I have two reasons for this.
They are reliability and gurantee.
First, travel with tour guide has reliability for time and schedule.
When i go to travel alone, I sometimes miss a transportation what we need to get on or a park I want to visit is closed.
But if we go to travel with tour guide, we can not miss it and we can visit there.
I hate to worry about anything except from enjoying.
When I go to travel to see something I want, we do not know about when it is open or close even though I study before, it might be suddenly close.
we can not reach the purpose of that tour.
Second, I have certainly gurantee which is kind of insurance in travel with tour guide.
Though sometimes we have a sick such as headache and cold even though heart diseases, if we are with the tour guide, he takes us to the proper hospital or the place to rest.
That is a big useful in travel.
when also we have a possiblity to meet accidents such as car accident and something mine stolen, he will contact with local police and might get back.
In terrible situation such as a sick or accident, we can rely on the tour guide.
On the other hand, if we go to travel alone, we can not rely on anyone, so we should communicate with your stranger and negotiate.
That needs vast work and getting exhauseted.
In conclusion, when I go to travel, I am always together with my tour guide.
It is the most useful way for us to enjoy our travel.
Thus I would go to travel ina group led by a tour guide.
And I recommend you to go to travel with a tour guide for your most happiness.
